description: Context-enriching knowledge graph that captures database topology, business concepts, and taxonomies to guide LLM decisions through subgraph injection

tool_definition.name: TDA_KnowledgeGraph
tool_definition.description: Queries, visualizes, and versions the knowledge graph. Use 'query' to find related entities, 'visualize' to render a subgraph, 'open' to open the full graph panel (works from any session), 'add_entity'/'add_relationship' to enrich it, 'snapshot' to save a version, 'versions' to list version history, 'restore' to roll back to a prior version, 'compile_metric' to get ready-to-run SQL for a metric slice, 'probe_bridge' to compile evidence for a declared cross-product link.

bridge_name.description: Declared cross-product link to probe — required for 'probe_bridge'. Matches on the bridge's label.

entity_name.description: Name of the entity to query, add, or center visualization on

properties.description: Properties for the entity (e.g., description, data_type, business_meaning)

target_entity.description: Target entity name for relationship creation

target_entity_type.description: Target entity type for relationship creation

query_text.description: For 'query': the ONE concept to look up — an entity, column or term name (the lookup matches entity names and descriptions; a whole question matches nothing as a phrase and is then searched by its terms). For 'get_context': the free text to ground.

entity.description: For 'declare_concept': the entity the concept is declared on (also accepted as 'entity_name').

concept_name.description: For 'declare_concept': the business term to declare (e.g. a category of records the product never defined).

definition.description: For 'declare_concept': the plain-language definition of the concept.

predicate.description: For 'declare_concept': ONE boolean SQL condition over the entity's declared columns (no statements). It becomes the term's rule, a compilable metric and a recipe. Refused if it names a column the entity does not declare.

intensity_tooltips.medium: Use graph context as guidance when available
intensity_tooltips.heavy: Strictly validate against graph; proactively enrich
